# BetterCtrlV

BetterCtrlV is a Windows clipboard app from ForumCore.

Canonical product page: https://forumcore.ai/betterctrlv/
Publisher: ForumCore, https://forumcore.ai/

Tap Ctrl+V to paste as usual. Hold Ctrl+V to pick an older copy — the current clipboard and the last nine. History stays on your PC, encrypted for your Windows account. It does not use a cloud clipboard. Copies from password managers are not saved.

Try it 15 days in the Microsoft Store, then buy there. Search the Store for BetterCtrlV.

Privacy: https://forumcore.ai/betterctrlv/privacy.html
Terms: https://forumcore.ai/betterctrlv/terms.html
Sitemap: https://forumcore.ai/sitemap.xml
